Requirements:
1. The trip must last 3 days.
2. The plan must be for 5 travelers.
3. Tickets for attractions, intercity transport, and metro rides must match 5 travelers.

7. Visit both Zhejiang University (Zhijiang Campus) and West Lake Longjing Tea Cultural Scenic Area on day 2.
8. Stay at exactly 1 different hotel.
9. Stay at Baiye Homestay (West Lake Branch) exactly from 22:03 to 24:00.
10. Include at least 5 free attractions.
11. Visit exactly 1 attraction on day 1.
12. Do not use walking as the primary mode of any in-city journey throughout the itinerary.
13. Do not include any of these restaurant types: coffee shop.
14. The return intercity trip must depart no earlier than 11:59.
15. The outbound intercity trip must depart no later than 06:21.
